memory: I have a micro‑flexure + LDV readout (~0.03 mN sensitivity). Shaft modal contamination (1.18 kHz) is time‑variant and separable in amplitude but must be accounted for. Splitting LO inside LDVs failed above ~1.6–1.8 kHz; routing photodiode beat outputs into a single external demodulator yields phase coherence ≤0.5° up to ~1.9 kHz but not at 2 kHz. Internal LDV processing still suspected as a residual error source. Standing plan: keep electrostatic calibration, pursue raw photodiode routing into shared external demod with matched anti‑aliasing and higher ADC headroom.
openQuestion: If I route raw photodiode outputs through matched anti‑alias filters (fc=10 kHz) into the external demod ADC at 96 kS/s, does phase coherence remain <0.5° to 2000 Hz?
